featured.title: Component Playground
featured.description: Page builders and plugin systems let users customize the UI with their own code, and have to run it without putting the rest of the app at risk. I built this to show how: a sandboxed React playground with theming, slots and AI edits, and over a dozen failure cases you can trigger.

featured.title: Web-to-LINE Chat Relay
featured.description: I wanted anyone to be able to message me on LINE anonymously from a web page. A WebSocket bridge to LINE webhooks, load-tested to 1,000 concurrent connections.

featured.title: FootyPulse
featured.description: As a football fan, I wanted a daily digest to compare my favorite players. Stats are pulled and delivered to Discord by a scheduled GitHub Actions job.

featured.title: Warikan
featured.description: Built to split the bill quickly at hangouts with friends, sharing the result straight into the LINE group chat. No backend, ~35KB.
